cohort: 121 nulliparous women delivering a singleton fetus weighing ≥ 4500 g in two tertiary medical centers between 2007 and 2018
finding: While trial of vaginal delivery in nulliparous women with fetuses ≥ 4500 g was associated with a high failure rate, neonatal outcomes mostly did not differ according to the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The rates of shoulder dystocia and anal sphincter injury in vaginal deliveries were 5/50 (10%) and 2/50 (4%) respectively.
